title: Hardship Share in Appointment Series Same-Day Cancellation Fees
content:
Decision table — Patient Hardship Discount Program determinations and the same-day cancellation fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The same-day hardship share is 0 percent where the patient holds an approved hardship determination whose effective date has arrived and whose expiry date has not passed at a level whose discount percentage is 75 or more, 100 percent less the level's discount percentage where such an approved determination in force discounts more than zero but less than 75 percent, and 100 percent where no approved determination is in force. The share is read as a percentage of the same-day basis and multiplies it.

**Records read.** The patient's Patient Hardship Discount Program determination: status, effective date, expiry date, and its level's discount percentage. In force means approved, effective on or before the assessment date and expiring on or after it.

| Approved | Effective date on or before assessment | Expiry date on or after assessment | Level discount | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | 75 percent or more | 0 percent |
| yes | yes | yes | above zero, below 75 percent | 100 percent less the discount |
| yes | yes | yes | zero | 100 percent |
| yes | no | — | any | 100 percent |
| yes | — | no | any | 100 percent |
| no | — | — | any | 100 percent |

**Example (hypothetical figures).** In force at a level discounting 50 percent, on a same-day basis of USD 62.50: 50 percent of USD 62.50 is USD 31.25.
